entities.summary: Hermann of Cilli, also known as Armand de Cilli, or Herniosus mit dem Bruche, was born in Cilli, the illegitimate son, although later legitimated, of Count Hermann II of Celje, of the family of the Counts of Cilli and Sanneck, whose family seat was in Celje Castle.
